question: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?
sql:
WITH team_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        season,
        SUM(CAST(home_team_goal AS INTEGER)) AS total_goals
    FROM Match
    WHERE home_team_goal IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id, season
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        season,
        SUM(CAST(away_team_goal AS INTEGER)) AS total_goals
    FROM Match
    WHERE away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY away_team_api_id, season
),
team_season_total AS (
    SELECT 
        team_api_id,
        season,
        SUM(total_goals) AS season_total_goals
    FROM team_season_goals
    GROUP BY team_api_id, season
),
max_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        team_api_id,
        MAX(season_total_goals) AS max_goals
    FROM team_season_total
    GROUP BY team_api_id
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY max_goals) AS median_max_goals FROM max_season_goals
